channel.title: AMNI-SCIENT Updates
channel.description: What shipped, what it means, why it matters.

item.title: Amni OS 0.4.4 ISO
item.description: I wanted to leave Windows without learning a shell, so I baked a desktop that doesn't make you. Here's the 0.4.4 ISO.

item.title: Research pages say what the proofs say
item.description: The research pages were claiming more than the numbers on them, so I went through all eight.

item.title: Amni v2 plays in the browser
item.description: I wanted the Amni remake right in the tab, no installer. It's live at /game/v2/.

item.title: Amni-Browse on the phone and on Windows
item.description: I wanted a browser that only talks to the pages I open. Now it comes as a signed Android APK and a Windows zip.

item.title: Amni-Connect installers for Windows and Linux
item.description: Amni-Connect lets you host on your own machine and view it from any browser, with nothing in the cloud. Now it has real installers.

item.title: HedgeDoc on Android
item.description: An unofficial native Android client for HedgeDoc 1.x and 2 that works with the server you already run.

item.title: Grok Remote on Windows is a real app
item.description: The PC side of Grok Remote used to live in a browser tab. Now it's a proper Windows app.

item.title: A swipe keyboard that stays on the phone
item.description: Amni-Type is an Android keyboard where swipe, next-word, and corrections all run on the device.

item.title: Grok Remote is easier to live with
item.description: I use Grok Remote from my phone and my PC, and a few small things were making that annoying. They're fixed.

item.title: Updates now live on amni-scient.com
item.description: This is the ship log. A dated post goes up whenever something you can actually use lands.

item.title: All eight Braid seats are live
item.description: Braid puts every AI you already pay for at one table, and all eight seats are open now.
